summary: Iteration 9 fully verified end-to-end. Seeded 2 live_streams into Mongo → re-visited /dashboard/live-slot: badge updated to 'Streams: 2 / 3', active-streams-list rendered with 2 rows testid'd active-stream-{stream_id} + stop-stream-{stream_id} for each. Clicked stop-stream-seed_ui_7a5004f9 → that row disappeared from DOM (verified `active-stream-seed_ui_7a5004f9` no longer queryable), only 1 row remained, badge updated to 'Streams: 1 / 3'. Frontend E2E on /dashboard/videos: uploaded video shows video-duration-{id} chip='0:03' and video-resolution-{id} chip='240p' — ffprobe values match the underlying MP4 dimensions. All specified data-testids are present and functional.

minor.endpoint: pytest -k Iter9 with default -n auto xdist
minor.issue: test_multi_slot_count_enforcement_via_seed FAILS when run in parallel because TestIter9StreamsList::test_admin_streams_empty_default (running on a different worker) does update_many({user_id:admin, is_live:True},{is_live:False}) which wipes the seeded rows mid-test. Serial run (-o addopts='') passes 11/11. Not a product bug — test-isolation only. Recommend adding @pytest.mark.xdist_group('iter9_admin_streams') to serialize admin-live-streams tests OR use per-test unique dummy users.

action_items: OPTIONAL test-hygiene: add pytest xdist_group markers to the Iter9 admin-live-streams tests so `pytest -n auto` runs 11/11 without ordering races (they already pass 11/11 in serial mode). Non-blocking.

OPTIONAL code review: /api/health builds SHA via subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--short','HEAD']) on every call — cheap but unnecessary. Cache at import time or read BUILD_SHA env once and memoize.

OPTIONAL: TestIter9DashboardStats depends on stopping any existing admin streams — fine when preview cluster is idle, but if a real admin starts a stream via UI concurrently it could flake. Consider seeding a dedicated admin-like user for stats tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /streams (1513-1531): returns _id excluded via projection ({_id:0}) — good. Correctly reads user['stream_slots'] with default 1.

server.py start-with-key (1533-1596): correct check order — plan → stream_key validation → video ownership → slot count → dup key → ffmpeg spawn. count_documents({user_id, is_live:True}) is efficient (indexed on user_id via existing videos index but NOT explicitly on live_streams — consider adding db.live_streams.create_index('user_id')). Response includes slot:{used, max} — spec-compliant.

server.py stop (1599-1631): correctly accepts optional stream_id in body; sort by started_at DESC for 'most recent' fallback is right. Idempotent (returns 'Already stopped' if none). Uses stream['_id'] for the update filter — safe.

server.py /health (1670-1705): git rev-parse called via subprocess on every request (timeout=2s). LOW-RISK perf issue but recommend memoizing at module load: `_BUILD_SHA_CACHE = None` and compute once. Also `git rev-parse` fails silently → 'unknown', which is graceful.

server.py ffprobe block (735-782): uses csv=p=0 for stream data + separate duration query, parses with try/except per line — resilient. Uses asyncio subprocess with 6s wait — good non-blocking. duration string built as MM:SS not HH:MM:SS for videos >=1h (won't handle 4-digit-min videos well, but corner case).
LiveSlot.jsx: correct — polls /api/streams on mount + after start/stop, splices active row from state on successful stop response, updates slotInfo. data-testids all present.
VideoManager.jsx: renders resolution chip only when height>0 (spec says only if height>0) — correct. Duration chip renders when duration string non-empty.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 iter-9 tests pass serial; 10/11 under default -n auto xdist due to test-isolation race — NOT a product bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (slot-budget-badge, active-streams-list, active-stream-{id}, stop-stream-{id}, video-duration-{id}, video-resolution-{id} — all present and functional; stop click removes row + updates badge)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 all green: 11/11 new backend tests (serial), full frontend E2E on /dashboard/live-slot and /dashboard/videos, GSC file + meta both verified. Key notes: (1) ffmpeg/ffprobe are already installed in this preview container from iter-8 (v5.1.9); no need to re-install. (2) BUILD_SHA env is empty so /api/health falls back to `git rev-parse --short HEAD` which returns 'cd31efa' — if the container is rebuilt without .git, this becomes 'unknown'. Main agent should ensure deploy script writes BUILD_SHA into backend/.env. (3) Multi-slot count check runs BEFORE ffmpeg spawn, so slot enforcement tests DO NOT require ffmpeg. (4) In pytest xdist parallel mode, admin-live-streams tests race with each other — recommend adding xdist_group markers in a future cleanup pass. (5) The stale iter-1/2 admin='monthly' tests noted in iter_8 are still there and will still fail if you run the full suite; they're unrelated to iter-9 features.
rca of the issue: No product bugs. Only a test-isolation flake in pytest xdist parallel mode where two Iter9 test classes both mutate admin's live_streams collection. Root cause: TestIter9StreamsList::test_admin_streams_empty_default calls db.live_streams.update_many({user_id:admin, is_live:True},{is_live:False}) as a setup step, which wipes the seeded rows that TestIter9MultiSlot::test_multi_slot_count_enforcement_via_seed relies on. Mitigation: (a) run with `-o addopts=''` to disable xdist (works 11/11), OR (b) add `@pytest.mark.xdist_group(name='admin_streams')` to both classes so they serialize onto the same worker, OR (c) use a dedicated non-admin fresh user with stream_slots forced to 3 in Mongo so it doesn't conflict with the shared admin session used elsewhere.
